% Pattern: number/ref. A manual head in the introduction that writes its number
% as a reference prints the number of the item of the label. Seen in the gold
% pilot (set X).
% want head-1 statement/theorem 2.2
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 2.1
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2.2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\begin{document}
\section{Introduction}
We prove one result.

\noindent
{\bf Theorem \ref{thm:main}.} {\em Every compact space is bounded.}

\section{Main}
\begin{theorem}\label{thm:other} Every finite space is compact. \end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}\label{thm:main} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\end{document}
